```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(glue)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(forcats)
library(UpSetR)
```

```{r load data}
clin <- read_csv("/fs/ess/PAS1695/projects/ppiio/data/clinical_TCC000138_formatted.csv", na = ".") %>%
  rename(days = "Days_Btwn-Collect_and_LastFUp/Death") %>%
  mutate(Vital_Status = ifelse(Vital_Status == "Alive", 0, 1))
```

```{r}
meds_iostart = c("H2B_collection", "PPI_collection")

forms <- list()
for(var in meds_iostart){
  forms[[var]] <- as.formula(paste("Surv(days, Vital_Status) ~ ", var, sep = ""))
}

sfits <- surv_fit(formula = forms, data = clin)
names(sfits) <- meds_iostart
almeds.plots <- ggsurvplot(sfits, pval = TRUE, conf.int = FALSE, 
                           risk.table = TRUE,title = "", legend.title = "", 
                           legend.labs = list(c("Not prescribed", "Prescribed")), 
                           ylab = "", xlab = "Days", palette = c("slateblue2", "lightsalmon2"), 
                           fontsize = 6, font.legend = list(size = 12))
```

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=9}
almeds.plots[["PPI_collection"]]
almeds.plots[["H2B_collection"]]
```
